selection: Eight locked never-matrix-exposed public identities selected after isolated sealed boolean scoreability admission. H63 governs failure accounting while H62 remains the semantic arm comparison. Each shared trajectory pauses before accepting its first terminal candidate, fresh-context pressure, incomplete-output pressure, or accounted malformed-response pressure, then forks to one control review and one compact-slate review.
instrument_treatment: Validator-proven indeterminate calls debit their full admitted bound; affected pairs are symmetric zeros and later independent tasks continue.
treatment: Exactly one review call after a completion-or-accounted-response boundary, with one receipt-bound compact evidence slate v2 at most 4,096 bytes and 1,024 provider-measured tokens. It ranks paths by observable task agreement and attention and represents each with maximum task-body agreement followed by minimum width. Control receives no slate.

branch_order.method: alternating control-first and slate-first by locked task order

stopping_rules: Every scheduled identity remains in the fixed denominator.
A validator-proven zero-byte indeterminate call is debited at its full admitted bound and its pair is retained as symmetric zeros.
Any unbounded usage, ancestry, sole-prompt-difference, one-call, exposure, or token-bound violation pauses before the next task.
claim_ceiling: Fresh GLM-5.3-flash 8K development canary only; not benchmark clearance
